name: glitchdeck
description: A mod that docks a live pane beside your conversation: what Claude is doing right now, every agent, workflow and background task it started as a process you can open, how fast it is writing, and every prompt you sent, one click away from its place in the transcript

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the pane when a session starts (it waits for a 144-column terminal, or 110 if you opened it yourself before and haven't closed it since)
